title: Add prompt-regression CI hook and quality gating to eval-harness
author: Samir Patel
release_notes: Adds a CI hook that runs eval-harness prompt-set regression checks and blocks merges on quality regressions. Configurable thresholds per repo/team, opt-out label for emergency merges, and docs for rollout.
description: Context: We want to prevent prompt-set quality regressions from being merged into main without detection. This PR wires a new CI job that runs the eval-harness prompt-regression checks against a pinned set of canary prompts and enforces a quality gate. Motivation: catch regressions early and provide deterministic CI feedback for model and infra changes. What changed: added a reusable GitHub Actions workflow eval-prompt-regression, implemented gating logic and threshold config in eval-harness/src/gates/prompt_regression_gate.py, added unit and integration tests, updated docs and examples, and added a small configmap for helm deployment in case teams want to run the hook as part of self-hosted CI. The gating is opt-in per repo via a top-level eval.yml config and supports per-team thresholds as well as an emergency 'ci/skip-eval-gate' label to bypass blocking in incident scenarios. The description below includes the checklist and testing notes. Checklist: - Add GH Actions workflow and action inputs for model selection and threshold - Implement gating logic to return non-zero exit code on regression beyond threshold - Add tests covering a small synthetic regression and a passing run - Update docs and rollout notes - Add opt-out label and Linear link to rollout plan (ENG-4021). Testing: local unit tests and a run on the integrated infra verified a passing baseline and a synthetic regression failure. CI run initially failed due to runner python path on windows; fixed by pinning python and adjusting PATH in the workflow. Backwards compatibility: default gating thresholds are conservative and must be enabled by teams. Rollout plan: start with canary on redwood-examples and redwood-docs, then expand to core services. See linked Linear ENG-4021 for rollout schedule and PM notes.
